articles.title: Himachal Pradesh: Speeding Car Hits Toll Worker at Parwanoo Plaza, Driver Flees
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A toll plaza worker was allegedly hit by a speeding car after the driver attempted to evade payment at the Old Barrier Toll Plaza in Parwanoo, Himachal Pradesh's Solan district, late on Tuesday night. The entire incident was captured on CCTV.

body.html:
A toll plaza worker was allegedly hit by a speeding car after the driver attempted to evade payment at the Old Barrier Toll Plaza in Parwanoo, Himachal Pradesh's Solan district, late on Tuesday night. The entire incident was captured on CCTV.

According to police, the toll employee, Gurvinder Singh alias Goldy Brar, a resident of Bathinda in Punjab, signalled the car to stop for toll collection. Instead of halting, the driver allegedly steered the vehicle towards him, hit him and fled the scene.

Gurvinder Singh sustained injuries to his hand and abdomen and was rushed to a hospital, where he is undergoing treatment.

DSP Parwanoo Anil said police have seized the car, bearing registration number HR-49-8316, and identified the accused, who has been summoned for questioning. According to reports, the accused is a resident of Malla village near Kalka.

Toll management said the vehicle was identified through its FASTag records, which helped police trace the car.

An FIR has been registered, and further investigation is underway.

#HimachalPradesh #Parwanoo #Solan #CCTV

articles.title: Tension in UP's Pilibhit After Youth Allegedly Stabbed Inside Home Following Minor Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension prevailed in Uttar Pradesh's Pilibhit district after a youth was allegedly assaulted and stabbed inside his house following a minor dispute in Neuria town. Police have registered a case and launched a search for the accused.

body.html:
Tension prevailed in Uttar Pradesh's Pilibhit district after a youth was allegedly assaulted and stabbed inside his house following a minor dispute in Neuria town. Police have registered a case and launched a search for the accused.

According to police, the incident began with a dispute around 5 pm on Monday. Later in the evening, Anil, a resident of Mohalla Kheda Peepal, alleged that Wasim, Kamil, Chhote, Sohil, Aqeel Khan and another unidentified person entered his house and attacked him.

The complainant alleged that the accused abused him and assaulted him when he objected. During the attack, one of the accused allegedly stabbed Anil in the hand, leaving him seriously injured. The group also allegedly threatened to kill him and his family and drive them out of the locality.

After receiving a Dial-112 call, police reached the spot and shifted the injured man to hospital for treatment.

As the incident involved members of two communities, additional police personnel were deployed in the area to maintain law and order. Circle Officer Sadar Natasha Goyal and the local police force also visited the spot to bring the situation under control.

Meanwhile, local residents have put forward a different version of events. According to some residents, a differently-abled man identified as Wasim was passing through the area when he objected to stone-pelting during the dispute and was allegedly assaulted. A CCTV video of the incident has also surfaced on social media.

Station House Officer Digambar Singh said an FIR has been registered against five named accused and one unidentified person under relevant provisions related to assault and criminal intimidation. Police said raids are underway to arrest the accused and further investigation is in progress.

#UttarPradesh #Pilibhit #Neuria #CrimeNews #Assault

articles.title: UP Newborn Death Sparks Outrage: Family Alleges Bribe Demand, Medical Negligence at Fatehpur CHC
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A newborn died after delivery at a Community Health Centre (CHC) in Uttar Pradesh's Fatehpur district, with the family alleging that hospital staff demanded money, delayed treatment and referral, leading to the infant's death.

body.html:
A newborn died after delivery at a Community Health Centre (CHC) in Uttar Pradesh's Fatehpur district, with the family alleging that hospital staff demanded money, delayed treatment and referral, leading to the infant's death.

The incident took place on Sunday at CHC Sarai Khalish in the Asothar area. Following the death, the family staged a protest at the hospital and lodged complaints with the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) and the local police.

According to the family, 25-year-old Sanyogita was admitted to the CHC at around 6 am after going into labour. She delivered the baby at around 2 pm, but the newborn's condition reportedly deteriorated soon afterwards.

The family alleged that despite the baby's critical condition, timely treatment was not provided and there was a delay in referring the newborn to the district hospital. The infant was referred at around 4 pm, where doctors declared the baby dead on arrival.

The baby's father, Arpit, alleged that an Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) demanded ₹2,100 and a private midwife demanded ₹1,100 for the delivery. He claimed that because he could not immediately pay the full amount, negligence occurred during the newborn's treatment. He also alleged that he has video evidence of money being accepted by hospital staff.

The ANM denied the allegations, stating that the delivery was normal and the newborn was referred promptly after the condition worsened. She also denied demanding money, claiming the family had voluntarily given her cash as a token of appreciation.

Police reached the hospital after receiving information about the protest and pacified the family. During the protest, local residents also raised concerns over the absence of a permanent female doctor at the CHC.

Chief Medical Officer Udaybhan Singh said an impartial inquiry has been ordered. He said strict action would be taken if the investigation establishes negligence or any irregularity by the health staff. The health department and police are investigating the matter.

#Fatehpur #UttarPradesh #MedicalNegligence #NewbornDeath

articles.title: Maharashtra: Armed Robbers Storm Jewellery Shop in Broad Daylight, Loot Gold and Silver Worth Lakhs
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Three armed men allegedly carried out a daring daylight robbery at a jewellery shop in Maharashtra's Palghar district, looting gold and silver ornaments worth several lakhs before fleeing on a motorcycle.

body.html:
Three armed men allegedly carried out a daring daylight robbery at a jewellery shop in Maharashtra's Palghar district, looting gold and silver ornaments worth several lakhs before fleeing on a motorcycle.

The incident took place at around 4.30 pm on Monday at Lakshmi Jewellers in Irani Nagar, Dahanu. According to reports, the accused entered the shop armed with weapons and threatened the shopkeeper before looting valuables.

During the robbery, one of the accused allegedly fired a shot inside the shop to intimidate those present. After collecting the jewellery, the three men fled from the scene on a single motorcycle.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed inside the shop, while several bystanders outside were seen recording videos on their mobile phones.

Police teams from Dahanu Police Station, the Crime Branch and senior officers rushed to the spot after receiving information. The area was cordoned off, and forensic experts examined the crime scene and collected evidence.

Police said efforts are underway to identify and trace the accused using CCTV footage and other technical evidence. A case has been registered, and further investigation is in progress.

The incident has triggered concern among jewellers and local traders, who have demanded the immediate arrest of those involved and enhanced security measures in the area.

#Palghar #Dahanu #Maharashtra #JewelleryRobbery #CrimeNews

articles.title: Gurugram: Basketball Pole Collapses on Resident, CCTV Captures Freak Accident That Left Him With
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 24-year-old resident of a housing society in Gurugram suffered three spinal fractures after a basketball pole allegedly collapsed on him while he was playing with friends, raising questions over the maintenance of common facilities.

body.html:
A 24-year-old resident of a housing society in Gurugram suffered three spinal fractures after a basketball pole allegedly collapsed on him while he was playing with friends, raising questions over the maintenance of common facilities.

The incident took place on Sunday evening at Antriksh Heights in Sector 84. The injured man, identified as Kartik Dalal, is undergoing treatment at a private hospital in Sector 90.

CCTV footage from the society shows a group of youngsters playing basketball. During the game, one of the players is seen briefly hanging from the basketball structure. Moments later, the pole suddenly tilts and collapses.

The heavy metal structure fell directly onto Kartik Dalal, who was standing beneath the basket. The footage shows him trapped under the collapsed pole before other players rushed to lift the structure and rescue him. He was then taken to a hospital, where his family said he was diagnosed with three spinal fractures.

Following the incident, Dalal's family and the Antriksh Heights Buyers' Association alleged negligence in the maintenance of the society's recreational infrastructure.

The association has demanded a detailed inquiry into the incident, action against those responsible and an independent structural safety audit of all common facilities to prevent similar accidents.

The incident has raised concerns among residents over the safety and maintenance of recreational amenities in residential societies. No official statement has been issued by the society's management or maintenance agency so far.

#Gurugram #Haryana #CCTV #Accident #ResidentialSociety

articles.title: Two Transgender Persons Detained After Viral Video Shows Passenger Being Beaten
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two transgender persons have been detained by the Government Railway Police (GRP) after they were allegedly caught on camera assaulting a man aboard a Mumbai local train following an argument. According to reports, the incident took place on July 18.

body.html:
Two transgender persons have been detained by the Government Railway Police (GRP) after they were allegedly caught on camera assaulting a man aboard a Mumbai local train following an argument.

According to reports, the incident took place on July 18. A verbal altercation allegedly broke out between a young man and a group of transgender persons while travelling on the local train. The dispute soon escalated into a physical assault.

A video of the incident, which has gone viral on social media, purportedly shows two transgender persons repeatedly slapping and punching the man, pulling his shirt and assaulting him in the presence of other passengers. The incident was reportedly recorded by a co-passenger.

Following the circulation of the video, the Government Railway Police (GRP) at Mumbai Central tracked down the two accused and detained them.

Police said legal proceedings have been initiated, and further details are awaited.

The incident has triggered widespread reactions online, with many users expressing concern over passenger safety and calling for strict action against those involved.

articles.title: Rajasthan: Leopard Enters Liquor Shop, Injures Three Before Being Locked Inside
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A leopard entered a liquor shop in Rajasthan's Tonk district on Sunday morning, attacked three people and was eventually locked inside the shop by a salesman before being rescued after a five-hour operation.

body.html:
A leopard entered a liquor shop in Rajasthan's Tonk district on Sunday morning, attacked three people and was eventually locked inside the shop by a salesman before being rescued after a five-hour operation.

According to forest officials, the incident took place in Todaraisingh town at around 8:45 am. Forest volunteer (Van Mitra) Rakesh was alerted by local residents about a leopard hiding in nearby bushes. When he approached the area, the animal allegedly attacked him before moving nearly 400 metres towards a liquor shop.

The leopard first attacked Fateh Lal Koli (40), who was sitting outside the shop. It then entered the liquor outlet and attacked salesman Sanjay Gurjar (25).

Despite the attack, Sanjay managed to escape and locked the leopard inside the shop, preventing it from causing further harm.

A forest department rescue team from Jaipur reached the spot at around 2 pm and safely captured the leopard after a rescue operation lasting nearly five hours.

All three injured men were taken to hospital by local residents. Rakesh was discharged after receiving first aid, while Sanjay Gurjar and Fateh Lal Koli were referred to another hospital for further treatment.

The incident drew a large crowd after news of the leopard's presence spread across the town.

#Rajasthan #Tonk #Leopard #Wildlife #ForestDepartment

articles.title: Chennai: Two Youths Allegedly Drive Under Influence of Ganja, Trigger Highway Chaos Before Fleeing
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two youths were arrested after allegedly driving a car under the influence of ganja and causing a series of accidents on the Salem–Chennai National Highway in Tamil Nadu, police said. According to reports, the car first rammed into another vehicle.

body.html:
Two youths were arrested after allegedly driving a car under the influence of ganja and causing a series of accidents on the Salem–Chennai National Highway in Tamil Nadu, police said.

According to reports, the car first rammed into another vehicle. Despite one of its tyres coming off during the incident, the driver allegedly continued speeding for several kilometres. The vehicle kept moving on its bare rim, sending sparks flying as it scraped against the road.

Alarmed by the dangerous driving, local residents chased the car and eventually managed to corner it. However, the two occupants allegedly abandoned the vehicle and fled from the scene.

Police reached the spot after receiving information and launched a search operation. The accused, identified as Deepak Guru and Thirumurugan, were later arrested.

A case has been registered, and further investigation is underway to determine the exact circumstances of the incident.

#Chennai #TamilNadu #RoadAccident #Ganja #DangerousDriving

articles.title: Wife Confronts Husband With Alleged Girlfriend, Heated Clash Sparks Chaos
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A commotion broke out at a guest house in Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Nagar in Uttar Pradesh's Chandauli district on Sunday after a woman allegedly caught her husband with another woman, leading to a heated confrontation.

body.html:
A commotion broke out at a guest house in Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Nagar in Uttar Pradesh's Chandauli district on Sunday after a woman allegedly caught her husband with another woman, leading to a heated confrontation.

According to local residents, the wife had been suspicious of her husband's activities for some time. After allegedly learning that he had gone to a guest house to meet another woman, she followed him to the location.

Upon reaching the guest house, the wife allegedly found her husband with his alleged girlfriend, triggering a heated argument.

Eyewitnesses said the verbal altercation soon escalated into a physical confrontation between the two women. The wife allegedly assaulted the other woman, while the husband attempted to intervene and calm the situation.

Hearing the commotion, local residents gathered outside the guest house and intervened, eventually bringing the situation under control and preventing the dispute from escalating further.

The people involved later left the spot after the matter was pacified by those present.

As of now, no complaint has reportedly been filed with the police, and no official statement has been issued regarding the incident. Police are expected to take action only if a formal complaint is received.

The incident has become a topic of discussion in the area and has also raised questions about visitor monitoring and security at guest houses.

#Chandauli #UttarPradesh #GuestHouse #ViralVideo

articles.title: Viral Video Allegedly Shows Bank Manager Locking Employees Inside Branch Over Overtime
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video purportedly showing a bank manager locking the gates of a branch and preventing employees from leaving after office hours has gone viral on social media, sparking outrage and reigniting debate over workplace pressure and employee rights.

body.html:
A video purportedly showing a bank manager locking the gates of a branch and preventing employees from leaving after office hours has gone viral on social media, sparking outrage and reigniting debate over workplace pressure and employee rights.

The incident is being linked on social media to the Arkalgud branch of Karnataka Grameena Bank, although the authenticity of the video and the exact circumstances have not been independently verified.

In the widely circulated clip, a man identified by social media users as the branch manager is seen locking the main gate with a padlock while allegedly telling employees they would not be allowed to leave until their work was completed.

The video captures an employee stating that his official duty hours had ended at 5 pm and that he had completed all assigned work. He also argues that working overtime is not compulsory.

The manager is heard responding that the employee would receive overtime pay and insists that overtime is "compulsory." When the employee asks where such a rule is mentioned, the manager allegedly refers to a "circular" but does not specify which one. The employee continues to question why the gate has been locked, while the manager allegedly refuses to provide a reason and asks him to justify why he wants to leave.

The video has triggered widespread criticism online, with many users alleging abuse of authority and questioning whether employees can legally be prevented from leaving the workplace after completing their official working hours.

However, the full context of the incident remains unclear. No official statement has yet been issued by Karnataka Grameena Bank, and the authenticity of the viral video has not been independently confirmed.

Further details are awaited.

#Karnataka #Bank #Workplace #Overtime #ViralVideo #EmployeeRights
